fr_html: Le PRESIDENT estime qu'il a le devoir de répondre à quelques objections formulées contre son projet et d'essayer de faire la lumière sur quelques points qui ont été signalés.
en_html: The PRESIDENT thought that it was his duty to answer some objections raised against his plan and to attempt to throw light on some points which had been brought out.
